title: Part 7 Email 與公告
summary: 辦公室清潔、大樓停水：找目的、時間、要做的事。

steps.title: 重點觀念
body: Part 7 的 email 和公告，第一、二句通常就說出目的。
題目問「要大家做什麼」，就去找 Please…、We suggest that…；問時間就找日期和星期。
注意寄信日期（Date: March 3）和活動日期（March 8）不一樣，是常見陷阱。

steps.title: 解題技巧

head: 題目
中文
去哪裡找
rows: What are staff asked to do?

steps.tip: 答案常是換句話說：take items off the floor ＝ remove items from the floor。

items.en: Please take all personal items off the floor.
items.zh: 請把所有個人物品從地上拿起來。

items.en: The office will be closed on Saturday.
We suggest that you store some water.
items.zh: 我們建議您先儲存一些水。

steps.title: 模擬練習
steps.intro: 每題都會顯示文章，看完題目再回文章找答案。⏱ 限時練習：每題建議 60 秒內作答，題號旁邊會倒數；超時不會被打斷。

questions.prompt: 這封 email 的目的是什麼？
options: To invite staff to a party
questions.explanation: 第一句就說地毯週六要清潔。
questions.sentence: What is the purpose of the email?
questions.text:
From: Anna Lee <anna.lee@brightdesign.com>
To: All Staff
Date: March 3
Subject: Office Cleaning

Hi everyone,

The carpets in our office will be cleaned this Saturday, March 8. Please take all personal items off the floor before you leave on Friday. The cleaning will take about five hours, so the office will be closed on Saturday. It will open again as usual on Monday morning.

Thank you,
Anna Lee
Office Manager

options: Come to work early on Monday
questions.explanation: take all personal items off the floor 換句話說就是 remove items from the floor。

questions.sentence: Why will the water be turned off?
questions.text:
Parkview Apartments — Notice to Residents

The water will be turned off on Wednesday, July 10, from 1 p.m. to 4 p.m. because workers will be repairing pipes on the third floor. We suggest that you store some water before 1 p.m. We are sorry for any trouble this may cause. If you have questions, please contact the building manager, Mr. Ortiz, at 555-0172.

questions.explanation: from 1 p.m. to 4 p.m.：下午一點到四點，共三個小時。
